      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "'''\n",
        "\n",
        "CODI ORIGINAL (TRIGA MOLTISSIM EN CARREGAR)\n",
        "\n",
        "def cargar_imagenes(df_subset):\n",
        "    X = []\n",
        "    y = []\n",
        "    for _, row in df_subset.iterrows():\n",
        "        img = Image.open(row[\"filepath\"]).resize(IMG_SIZE).convert(\"L\")\n",
        "        X.append(np.array(img, dtype=\"float32\") / 255.0)\n",
        "        y.append(label_to_id[row[\"label\"]])\n",
        "    X = np.array(X)[..., np.newaxis]  # shape: (N, 128, 128, 1)\n",
        "    y = to_categorical(y, num_classes=len(CLASS_NAMES))\n",
        "    return X, y\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Cargando train...\")\n",
        "X_train, y_train = cargar_imagenes(train_df)\n",
        "print(\"Cargando val...\")\n",
        "X_val, y_val = cargar_imagenes(val_df)\n",
        "print(\"Cargando test...\")\n",
        "X_test, y_test_cat = cargar_imagenes(test_df)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"X_train shape:\", X_train.shape)\n",
        "print(\"y_train shape:\", y_train.shape)\n",
        "\n",
        "'''\n",
        "\n",
        "#Amb l'ajuda de la IA, hem optimitzat el codi:\n",
        "\n",
        "def carregar_imatges_optimitzat(df_subset, img_size, label_to_id, num_classes):\n",
        "    n = len(df_subset)\n",
        "    H, W = img_size\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Pre-reservem l'espai en memòria per anar més ràpid\n",
        "    X = np.empty((n, H, W, 1), dtype=np.float32)\n",
        "    y = np.empty((n,), dtype=np.int32)\n",
        "\n",
        "    # itertuples és molt més ràpid que iterrows\n",
        "    for i, row in enumerate(df_subset.itertuples(index=False)):\n",
        "        fp = row.filepath\n",
        "        lab = row.label\n",
        "\n",
        "        with Image.open(fp) as im:\n",
        "            # Convertim a escala de grisos ('L') i redimensionem\n",
        "            im_res = im.convert(\"L\").resize((W, H))\n",
        "            # Normalitzem directament a [0, 1] com a la pràctica\n",
        "            X[i, :, :, 0] = np.asarray(im_res, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0\n",
        "\n",
        "        y[i] = label_to_id[lab]\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Passem a format categòric (one-hot) igual que a la pràctica 6\n",
        "    y_cat = to_categorical(y, num_classes=num_classes)\n",
        "    return X, y_cat\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Carregant dades de l'entrenament (train)...\")\n",
        "X_train, y_train_cat = carregar_imatges_optimitzat(train_df, IMG_SIZE, label_to_id, len(CLASS_NAMES))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Carregant dades de validació (val)...\")\n",
        "X_val, y_val_cat     = carregar_imatges_optimitzat(val_df,   IMG_SIZE, label_to_id, len(CLASS_NAMES))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Carregant dades de test...\")\n",
        "X_test, y_test_cat   = carregar_imatges_optimitzat(test_df,  IMG_SIZE, label_to_id, len(CLASS_NAMES))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Verificacions iguals que a la pràctica\n",
        "print(f\"\\nNou rang de X_train: [{X_train.min()}, {X_train.max()}]\")\n",
        "print(\"Shape de X_train:\", X_train.shape)\n",
        "print(\"Shape de y_train_cat:\", y_train_cat.shape)\n",
        "print(\"Exemple: y_train_cat[2]:\", y_train_cat[2])\n",
        "\n",
        "###ENCARA SEGUEIX TRIGANT MOLT!"
      ],

        "\n",
        "def plot_digits(X, y, n=10):\n",
        "    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 3))\n",
        "    for i in range(n):\n",
        "        plt.subplot(2, 5, i + 1)\n",
        "        plt.imshow(X[i].squeeze(), cmap=\"gray\")\n",
        "        plt.title(f\"Etiqueta: {id_to_label[np.argmax(y[i])]}\")\n",
        "        plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plot_digits(X_train, y_train_cat, n=10)"

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "###Model bàsic (MLP)\n",
        "###MODEL PESSAT FET AMB KERAS (3 CAPES OCULTES AMB 256 NEURONES I ACTIVACIÓ RELU)\n",
        "###USAREM EARLYSTOP A TOTS ELS MODELS JA QUE ES UN MÉTODE QUE S'HA CREGUT IMPRESCINDIBLE PER ARRIBAR AL MÀXIM RENDIMENT DELS MODELS\n",
        "\n",
        "mlp = Sequential([\n",
        "    Input(shape=(*IMG_SIZE, 1)),\n",
        "    Flatten(),\n",
        "    Dense(256, activation=\"relu\"),\n",
        "    Dense(256,  activation=\"relu\"),\n",
        "    Dense(256,  activation=\"relu\"),\n",
        "    Dense(3, activation=\"softmax\")\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "mlp.summary()\n",
        "\n",
        "mlp.compile(\n",
        "    optimizer=\"adam\",\n",
        "    loss=\"categorical_crossentropy\",\n",
        "    metrics=[\"accuracy\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "earlystop=EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=5, restore_best_weights=True) ###Parar els bucle si ha arribat al màxim.\n",
        "hist_mlp = mlp.fit(\n",
        "    X_train, y_train_cat,\n",
        "    validation_data=(X_val, y_val_cat),\n",
        "    epochs=50, ###Com utilitzem earlystop, possem un nombre alt d'epochs\n",
        "    callbacks=[earlystop],\n",
        "    verbose=1\n",
        ")"

        "#GRAFIQUEM LES CORBES D'APRENENTATGE PER OBSERVAR EL COMPORTAMENT DELS MODELS I SI PRESENTES OVERFITTING\n",
        "\n",
        "def plot_entrenament(entrenament, titol=\"\"):\n",
        "    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 4))\n",
        "    plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)\n",
        "    plt.plot(entrenament.history[\"loss\"],     label=\"train\")\n",
        "    plt.plot(entrenament.history[\"val_loss\"], label=\"validation\")\n",
        "    plt.title(f\"Loss {titol}\")\n",
        "    plt.legend()\n",
        "    plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)\n",
        "    plt.plot(entrenament.history[\"accuracy\"],     label=\"train\")\n",
        "    plt.plot(entrenament.history[\"val_accuracy\"], label=\"validation\")\n",
        "    plt.title(f\"Accuracy {titol}\")\n",
        "    plt.legend()\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plot_entrenament(hist_mlp, \"(MLP Pesada)\")\n",
        "plot_entrenament(hist_mlp2, \"(MLP Eficient)\")\n",
        "plot_entrenament(hist_mlp3, \"(MLP Equilibrada)\")"

        "\n",
        "mlp31=Sequential([\n",
        "    Input(shape=(*IMG_SIZE, 1)),\n",
        "    Flatten(),\n",
        "    Dense(128, activation=\"relu\"),\n",
        "    Dropout(0.3),\n",

        "\n",
        "mlp31.summary()\n",
        "\n",

        "    metrics=[\"accuracy\"]\n",
        ")\n",

        "###PASEM A UNA CNN AMB 5 CAPES DE Conv2D(32), Conv2D(64), Conv2D(128), Conv2D(128), flatten I 128 NEURONES AMB ACTIVACIÓ RELU, PADDING=SAME I MAXPOOLING2D((2,2))\n",
        "\n",
        "cnn = Sequential([\n",
        "    Input(shape=(*IMG_SIZE, 1)),\n",
        "\n",
        "    Conv2D(32, (3, 3), activation=\"relu\", padding=\"same\"),\n",
        "    MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),\n",
        "\n",
        "    Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation=\"relu\", padding=\"same\"),\n",
        "    MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),\n",
        "\n",
        "    Conv2D(128, (3, 3), activation=\"relu\", padding=\"same\"),\n",
        "    MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),\n",
        "\n",
        "    Conv2D(128, (3, 3), activation=\"relu\", padding=\"same\"),\n",
        "    MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),\n",
        "    Flatten(),\n",
        "    Dense(128, activation=\"relu\"),\n",
        "    Dropout(0.5),\n",
        "    Dense(3, activation=\"softmax\")\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "cnn.summary()\n",
        "\n",
        "cnn.compile(\n",
        "    optimizer=\"adam\",\n",
        "    loss=\"categorical_crossentropy\",\n",
        "    metrics=[\"accuracy\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "earlystop2=EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=5, restore_best_weights=True) ###Parar els bucle si ha arribat al màxim. (Les mètriques i la Loss empitjoren)\n",
        "\n",
        "hist_cnn = cnn.fit(\n",
        "    X_train, y_train_cat,\n",
        "    validation_data=\n",
        "    (X_val, y_val_cat),\n",
        "    epochs=50,\n",
        "    callbacks=[earlystop2],\n",
        "    verbose=1\n",

        "#FEM UNA PROVA DE TEST AMB ELS 2 TIPUS DE XARXA, MOSTRANT LA CONFUSSION MATRIX I DIVERSES MÉTRIQUES\n",
        "\n",
        "def evaluar_model(model, name):\n",
        "    loss, acc = model.evaluate(X_test, y_test_cat, verbose=1)\n",
        "    print(f\"\\n[{name}] Test loss: {loss:.4f}\")\n",
        "    print(f\"[{name}] Test accuracy: {acc:.4f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    y_prob = model.predict(X_test, verbose=0)\n",
        "    y_pred = np.argmax(y_prob, axis=1)\n",
        "    y_true = test_df[\"label\"].map(label_to_id).values\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(classification_report(y_true, y_pred, target_names=CLASS_NAMES, digits=4))\n",
        "\n",
        "    cm = confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred)\n",
        "    ConfusionMatrixDisplay(cm, display_labels=CLASS_NAMES).plot(cmap=\"Blues\")\n",
        "    plt.title(f\"Matriu de Confusió - {name}\")\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "    return y_true, y_pred, y_prob\n",
        "\n",
        "y_true_mlp, y_pred_mlp, y_prob_mlp = evaluar_model(mlp3, \"MLP Baseline\")\n",
        "y_true_cnn, y_pred_cnn, y_prob_cnn = evaluar_model(cnn, \"CNN Avanzada\")"

        "#MOSTREM CASOS QUE EÑ CNN HA PREDIT CORRECTAMENT I LES SEVES PROBABILITATS\n",
        "\n",
        "def plot_correctly_classified(X, y_true, y_pred, y_prob, n=8):\n",
        "    correctes = np.where(y_true == y_pred)[0]\n",
        "    print(f\"Total d'encerts: {len(correctes)}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    cols = 4\n",
        "    rows = (min(n, len(correctes)) + cols - 1) // cols\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.figure(figsize=(15, 4 * rows))\n",
        "\n",
        "    for i in range(min(n, len(correctes))):\n",
        "        idx = correctes[i]\n",
        "        plt.subplot(rows, cols, i + 1)\n",
        "        plt.imshow(X[idx].squeeze(), cmap=\"gray\")\n",
        "\n",
        "        probs_text = \"\\n\".join([f\"{CLASS_NAMES[j]}: {y_prob[idx][j]:.2%}\" for j in range(len(CLASS_NAMES))])\n",
        "\n",
        "        plt.title(f\"Real: {id_to_label[y_true[idx]]} | Pred: {id_to_label[y_pred[idx]]}\\n\\n{probs_text}\", fontsize=10)\n",
        "        plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plot_correctly_classified(X_test, y_true_cnn, y_pred_cnn, y_prob_cnn, n=8)"

        "#MOSTREM ALGUNS ERRORS I LES SEVES PROBABILITATS\n",
        "\n",
        "def plot_misclassified(X, y_true, y_pred, y_prob, n=8):\n",
        "    errors = np.where(y_true != y_pred)[0]\n",
        "    print(f\"Total d'errors: {len(errors)}\")\n",
        "    cols = 4\n",
        "    rows = (min(n, len(errors)) + cols - 1) // cols\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.figure(figsize=(15, 4 * rows))\n",
        "\n",
        "    for i in range(min(n, len(errors))):\n",
        "        idx = errors[i]\n",
        "        plt.subplot(rows, cols, i + 1)\n",
        "        plt.imshow(X[idx].squeeze(), cmap=\"gray\")\n",
        "        probs_text = \"\\n\".join([f\"{CLASS_NAMES[j]}: {y_prob[idx][j]:.2%}\" for j in range(len(CLASS_NAMES))])\n",
        "        plt.title(f\"Real: {id_to_label[y_true[idx]]} | Pred: {id_to_label[y_pred[idx]]}\\n\\n{probs_text}\", fontsize=10)\n",
        "        plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plot_misclassified(X_test, y_true_cnn, y_pred_cnn, y_prob_cnn, n=8)"

        "from sklearn.svm import SVC\n",
        "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score\n",
        "import time\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "\n",
        "###COMENCEM AMB EL MÉTODE CLASSIC I AMB L'ENSEMBLE POSTERIORMENT\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1. Aplanar les imatges per a Scikit-Learn (de 128x128x1 a vectors 1D de 16384)\n",
        "X_train_flat = X_train.reshape(X_train.shape[0], -1)\n",
        "X_val_flat = X_val.reshape(X_val.shape[0], -1)\n",
        "X_test_flat = X_test.reshape(X_test.shape[0], -1)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. Revertir el One-Hot Encoding a nombres enters (0, 1, o 2) per a sklearn\n",
        "y_train_int = np.argmax(y_train_cat, axis=1)\n",
        "y_val_int = np.argmax(y_val_cat, axis=1)\n",
        "y_test_int = np.argmax(y_test_cat, axis=1)\n",
        "\n",
        "# ==========================================\n",
        "# MODEL CLÀSSIC: Support Vector Machine (SVM)\n",
        "# ==========================================\n",
        "print(\"Entrenant SVM (Això pot trigar un parell de minuts)...\")\n",
        "start_time = time.time()\n",
        "\n",
        "svm_model = SVC(kernel='rbf', C=1.0, random_state=SEED)\n",
        "svm_model.fit(X_train_flat, y_train_int)\n",
        "\n",
        "svm_train_time = time.time() - start_time\n",
        "svm_preds = svm_model.predict(X_val_flat)\n",
        "svm_acc = accuracy_score(y_val_int, svm_preds)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"SVM -> Temps d'entrenament: {svm_train_time:.2f} s | Val Accuracy: {svm_acc:.4f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# ==========================================\n",
        "# ENSEMBLE (BAGGING): Random Forest\n",
        "# ==========================================\n",
        "print(\"\\nEntrenant Bagging (Random Forest)...\")\n",
        "start_time = time.time()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Random Forest crea un Bagging de 100 arbres de decisió independents\n",
        "rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=SEED, n_jobs=-1)\n",
        "rf_model.fit(X_train_flat, y_train_int)\n",
        "\n",
        "rf_train_time = time.time() - start_time\n",
        "rf_preds = rf_model.predict(X_val_flat)\n",
        "rf_acc = accuracy_score(y_val_int, rf_preds)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"Random Forest -> Temps d'entrenament: {rf_train_time:.2f} s | Val Accuracy: {rf_acc:.4f}\")"

      "source": [
        "import time\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "from sklearn.svm import SVC\n",
        "from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report, confusion_matrix\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"1. Reentrenando SVM con cálculo de probabilidades (PACIENCIA, tardará un rato)...\")\n",
        "# Es OBLIGATORIO poner probability=True para el Stacking\n",
        "svm_stacking = SVC(kernel='rbf', C=1.0, random_state=SEED, probability=True)\n",
        "svm_stacking.fit(X_train_flat, y_train_int)\n",
        "print(\"¡SVM listo!\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "# 2. GENERAR META-CARACTERÍSTIQUES (PROBABILITATS) EN VALIDACIÓ\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "print(\"\\n2. Extraint prediccions probabilístiques del conjunt de VALIDACIÓ...\")\n",
        "\n",
        "meta_cnn_val = cnn.predict(X_val, verbose=0)\n",
        "meta_svm_val = svm_stacking.predict_proba(X_val_flat) # AHORA USAMOS EL SVM\n",
        "meta_rf_val = rf_model.predict_proba(X_val_flat)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Concatenem les probabilitats (3 + 3 + 3 = 9 columnes)\n",
        "X_meta_val = np.hstack([meta_cnn_val, meta_svm_val, meta_rf_val])\n",
        "\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "# 3. ENTRENAR EL META-MODEL (EL DIRECTOR D'ORQUESTRA)\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "print(\"\\n3. Entrenant el Meta-Model (Regressió Logística)...\")\n",
        "meta_model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=SEED)\n",
        "meta_model.fit(X_meta_val, y_val_int)\n",
        "print(\"Meta-model entrenat!\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "# 4. AVALUAR EL RENDIMENT DE L'STACKING EN EL CONJUNT DE TEST\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "print(\"\\n4. Avaluant l'Stacking final amb el conjunt de TEST...\")\n",
        "\n",
        "meta_cnn_test = cnn.predict(X_test, verbose=0)\n",
        "meta_svm_test = svm_stacking.predict_proba(X_test_flat)\n",
        "meta_rf_test = rf_model.predict_proba(X_test_flat)\n",
        "\n",
        "X_meta_test = np.hstack([meta_cnn_test, meta_svm_test, meta_rf_test])\n",
        "\n",
        "stacking_preds = meta_model.predict(X_meta_test)\n",
        "stacking_acc = accuracy_score(y_test_int, stacking_preds)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"\\n==================================================\")\n",
        "print(f\" RENDIMENT DE L'STACKING (CNN + SVM + RF) EN TEST\")\n",
        "print(f\"==================================================\")\n",
        "print(f\"Precisió (Accuracy) de l'Stacking: {stacking_acc:.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"\\nInforme de Classificació Detallat:\\n\")\n",
        "print(classification_report(y_test_int, stacking_preds, target_names=CLASS_NAMES))\n",
        "\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "# 5. MATRIU DE CONFUSIÓ\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "cm = confusion_matrix(y_test_int, stacking_preds)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))\n",
        "sns.heatmap(cm, annot=True, fmt='d', cmap='Blues',\n",
        "            xticklabels=CLASS_NAMES, yticklabels=CLASS_NAMES)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Matriu de Confusió - Stacking (CNN+SVM+RF)\", fontsize=14)\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Classe Real (Cert)\", fontsize=12)\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Classe Predita\", fontsize=12)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"

        "from sklearn.metrics import f1_score\n",
        "\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "# 3. ENTRENAR EL META-MODEL (EL DIRECTOR D'ORQUESTRA)\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "print(\"\\n3. Entrenant el Meta-Model (Regressió Logística)...\")\n",
        "start_train_stacking = time.time()\n",
        "\n",
        "meta_model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=SEED)\n",
        "meta_model.fit(X_meta_val, y_val_int)\n",
        "\n",
        "stacking_train_time = time.time() - start_train_stacking\n",
        "print(f\"Meta-model entrenat!\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "# 4. AVALUAR EL RENDIMENT DE L'STACKING EN EL CONJUNT DE TEST\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "print(\"\\n4. Avaluant l'Stacking final amb el conjunt de TEST...\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Cronometrem tot el pipeline d'inferència (tots els models treballant)\n",
        "start_infer_stacking = time.time()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Pas A: Prediccions dels models base\n",
        "meta_cnn_test = cnn.predict(X_test, verbose=0)\n",
        "meta_svm_test = svm_stacking.predict_proba(X_test_flat)\n",
        "meta_rf_test = rf_model.predict_proba(X_test_flat)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Pas B: Apilar meta-característiques\n",
        "X_meta_test = np.hstack([meta_cnn_test, meta_svm_test, meta_rf_test])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Pas C: Decisió final del meta-model\n",
        "stacking_preds = meta_model.predict(X_meta_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "stacking_infer_time = time.time() - start_infer_stacking\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculem les mètriques finals\n",
        "stacking_acc = accuracy_score(y_test_int, stacking_preds)\n",
        "stacking_f1 = f1_score(y_test_int, stacking_preds, average='macro')\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"\\n==================================================\")\n",
        "print(f\" RENDIMENT DE L'STACKING (CNN + SVM + RF) EN TEST\")\n",
        "print(f\"==================================================\")\n",
        "print(f\"Stacking -> Temps d'entrenament (Meta-model): {stacking_train_time:.4f} s\")\n",
        "print(f\"Stacking -> Temps d'Inferència (Pipeline): {stacking_infer_time:.4f} s\")\n",
        "print(f\"Stacking -> Test Accuracy: {stacking_acc:.4f} | Test F1-Score: {stacking_f1:.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"\\nInforme de Classificació Detallat:\\n\")\n",
        "print(classification_report(y_test_int, stacking_preds, target_names=CLASS_NAMES))"
